title: Running Windows desktop tests from Linux with disposable VMs
title_zh: 使用一次性虚拟机在 Linux 上运行 Windows 桌面测试

paragraphs.en: There’s a good reason why testing Windows desktop apps was one of the most requested features from customers: no one in the world has the infrastructure to parallelize thousands of runs per month.
paragraphs.zh: 测试 Windows 桌面应用是客户呼声最高的功能之一，这是有充分理由的：世界上没有任何一家公司拥有每月并行运行数千次测试所需的基础设施。

paragraphs.en: Web testing infrastructure is relatively easy: a headless browser starts inside a Linux container in a couple seconds, costs a fraction of a cent to run, and gets thrown away when the test ends. There’s no equivalent for testing a Windows desktop app.
paragraphs.zh: Web 测试基础设施相对容易：无头浏览器可以在几秒钟内于 Linux 容器中启动，运行成本不到一美分，测试结束后即被丢弃。 测试 Windows 桌面应用没有对应的等价方案。

sents.en: Web testing infrastructure is relatively easy: a headless browser starts inside a Linux container in a couple seconds, costs a fraction of a cent to run, and gets thrown away when the test ends.
sents.zh: Web 测试基础设施相对容易：无头浏览器可以在几秒钟内于 Linux 容器中启动，运行成本不到一美分，测试结束后即被丢弃。

sents.en: There’s no equivalent for testing a Windows desktop app.
sents.zh: 测试 Windows 桌面应用没有对应的等价方案。

paragraphs.en: Our answer was to stop treating Windows machines as servers and treat them like phones: a device that one test claims, uses once, and throws away.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的答案是：不再把 Windows 机器当作服务器，而是把它们像手机一样对待——一种测试人员声明、使用一次后就丢弃的设备。

paragraphs.en: The basic architecture borrows from our mobile testing infrastructure, because mobile testing has the same constraints: the test code can't run on the device it's testing, and each test needs a device to itself while it runs. Since a Windows machine is modeled as a device in Kubernetes, a test can ask our custom device scheduler for a VM with a DeviceClaim , get its connection details back, control the device remotely through WebdriverIO and Appium, and release the machine when the test is done.
paragraphs.zh: 基本架构借鉴了我们的移动测试基础设施，因为移动测试面临同样的约束条件：测试代码无法运行在被测设备上，而且每个测试在运行时需要独占一台设备。 由于一台 Windows 机器在 Kubernetes 中被建模为一台设备，测试可以向我们的自定义设备调度器请求一台带有 DeviceClaim 的虚拟机，获取其连接信息，通过 WebdriverIO 和 Appium 远程控制该设备，并在测试完成后释放这台机器。

sents.en: The basic architecture borrows from our mobile testing infrastructure, because mobile testing has the same constraints: the test code can't run on the device it's testing, and each test needs a device to itself while it runs.
sents.zh: 基本架构借鉴了我们的移动测试基础设施，因为移动测试面临同样的约束条件：测试代码无法运行在被测设备上，而且每个测试在运行时需要独占一台设备。

sents.en: Since a Windows machine is modeled as a device in Kubernetes, a test can ask our custom device scheduler for a VM with a DeviceClaim , get its connection details back, control the device remotely through WebdriverIO and Appium, and release the machine when the test is done.
sents.zh: 由于一台 Windows 机器在 Kubernetes 中被建模为一台设备，测试可以向我们的自定义设备调度器请求一台带有 DeviceClaim 的虚拟机，获取其连接信息，通过 WebdriverIO 和 Appium 远程控制该设备，并在测试完成后释放这台机器。

paragraphs.en: Windows needed two extensions to the device model: a device no longer has to live inside the Kubernetes cluster (a GCE VM lives outside it entirely), and a claim can return a desktop's connection addresses, including CDP for browsers. Otherwise, the Windows runner follows the mobile runner's lifecycle step for step (claim, heartbeat, record, connect, run, release), tests talk to native apps through the same WebdriverIO and Appium pairing, and private Windows pools work the way private iOS devices do.
paragraphs.zh: Windows 需要对设备模型做两处扩展：设备不再必须位于 Kubernetes 集群内部（一台 GCE 虚拟机完全位于集群之外），并且一份声明（claim）可以返回桌面的连接地址，包括供浏览器使用的 CDP。 除此之外，Windows 运行器逐步遵循移动运行器的生命周期（声明、心跳、记录、连接、运行、释放），测试通过相同的 WebdriverIO 与 Appium 组合与原生应用通信，私有 Windows 池的工作方式也和私有 iOS 设备一样。

sents.en: Windows needed two extensions to the device model: a device no longer has to live inside the Kubernetes cluster (a GCE VM lives outside it entirely), and a claim can return a desktop's connection addresses, including CDP for browsers.
sents.zh: Windows 需要对设备模型做两处扩展：设备不再必须位于 Kubernetes 集群内部（一台 GCE 虚拟机完全位于集群之外），并且一份声明（claim）可以返回桌面的连接地址，包括供浏览器使用的 CDP。

sents.en: Otherwise, the Windows runner follows the mobile runner's lifecycle step for step (claim, heartbeat, record, connect, run, release), tests talk to native apps through the same WebdriverIO and Appium pairing, and private Windows pools work the way private iOS devices do.
sents.zh: 除此之外，Windows 运行器逐步遵循移动运行器的生命周期（声明、心跳、记录、连接、运行、释放），测试通过相同的 WebdriverIO 与 Appium 组合与原生应用通信，私有 Windows 池的工作方式也和私有 iOS 设备一样。

paragraphs.en: Try the AI testing platform that makes QA 12x faster.
paragraphs.zh: 体验能让 QA 效率提升 12 倍的 AI 测试平台。

paragraphs.en: Like the mobile system, it has three parts:
paragraphs.zh: 与移动系统一样，它有三个部分：

paragraphs.en: The runner talks to the VM over three connections. Playwright connects over CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) for anything in a browser. Appium handles native Windows apps. A WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communication) stream carries the screen so people can watch the test live and review a recording afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 运行器通过三条连接与虚拟机通信。 Playwright 通过 CDP（Chrome DevTools Protocol，Chrome 开发者工具协议）连接，处理浏览器中的任何操作。 Appium 负责处理原生 Windows 应用。 一条 WebRTC（Web Real-Time Communication，网页实时通信）视频流传输屏幕画面，便于人们实时观看测试并事后回看录制内容。

sents.en: The runner talks to the VM over three connections.
sents.zh: 运行器通过三条连接与虚拟机通信。

sents.en: Playwright connects over CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) for anything in a browser.
sents.zh: Playwright 通过 CDP（Chrome DevTools Protocol，Chrome 开发者工具协议）连接，处理浏览器中的任何操作。

sents.en: Appium handles native Windows apps.
sents.zh: Appium 负责处理原生 Windows 应用。

sents.en: A WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communication) stream carries the screen so people can watch the test live and review a recording afterward.
sents.zh: 一条 WebRTC（Web Real-Time Communication，网页实时通信）视频流传输屏幕画面，便于人们实时观看测试并事后回看录制内容。

paragraphs.en: Like an Android emulator, each Windows VM is disposable. Nobody logs into it, patches it or keeps it running for weeks. A test claims it, uses it once and gives it back, and a fresh VM takes its place.
paragraphs.zh: 就像安卓模拟器一样，每台 Windows 虚拟机都是一次性的。 没有人会登录它、给它打补丁，或者让它连续运行数周。 一项测试领取它、使用一次就归还它，随后一台全新的虚拟机取而代之。

sents.en: Like an Android emulator, each Windows VM is disposable.
sents.zh: 就像安卓模拟器一样，每台 Windows 虚拟机都是一次性的。

sents.en: Nobody logs into it, patches it or keeps it running for weeks.
sents.zh: 没有人会登录它、给它打补丁，或者让它连续运行数周。

sents.en: A test claims it, uses it once and gives it back, and a fresh VM takes its place.
sents.zh: 一项测试领取它、使用一次就归还它，随后一台全新的虚拟机取而代之。

paragraphs.en: Step 1 of 6 The test starts in a Linux runner pod, which asks for a Windows device.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 步（共 6 步）测试从 Linux 运行器 Pod 开始，它会请求一台 Windows 设备。

paragraphs.en: The first thing a Windows test does is ask for a Windows machine. Handing those out is the job of our device scheduler, the same in-house service that already hands out Android emulators. For Windows, we taught it two new jobs: keeping a stock of VMs rented from Google Compute Engine, and giving one to each test that asks.
paragraphs.zh: Windows 测试做的第一件事就是请求一台 Windows 机器。 分发这些机器是我们的设备调度器的职责，这个内部服务此前已经在分发 Android 模拟器。 针对 Windows，我们让它承担了两项新工作：维持一批从 Google Compute Engine 租用的虚拟机库存，并把其中一台分配给每个发起请求的测试。

sents.en: The first thing a Windows test does is ask for a Windows machine.
sents.zh: Windows 测试做的第一件事就是请求一台 Windows 机器。

sents.en: Handing those out is the job of our device scheduler, the same in-house service that already hands out Android emulators.
sents.zh: 分发这些机器是我们的设备调度器的职责，这个内部服务此前已经在分发 Android 模拟器。

sents.en: For Windows, we taught it two new jobs: keeping a stock of VMs rented from Google Compute Engine, and giving one to each test that asks.
sents.zh: 针对 Windows，我们让它承担了两项新工作：维持一批从 Google Compute Engine 租用的虚拟机库存，并把其中一台分配给每个发起请求的测试。

paragraphs.en: The scheduler tracks the fleet through three new Kubernetes custom resources:
paragraphs.zh: 调度器通过三个新的 Kubernetes 自定义资源来跟踪智能体集群：

paragraphs.en: Records like these are how the device scheduler already manages emulators, so Windows VMs fit into it without a separate system. They also keep the fleet's state durable and visible. If the scheduler restarts, it reads the records and picks up where it left off, and engineers can inspect any pool or VM with standard Kubernetes tools.
paragraphs.zh: 设备调度器已经通过这类记录来管理模拟器，因此 Windows 虚拟机无需单独的系统即可纳入其中。 这些记录还能让集群的状态持久化且可见。 如果调度器重启，它会读取这些记录并从中断处继续，工程师也可以使用标准的 Kubernetes 工具检查任意资源池或虚拟机。

sents.en: Records like these are how the device scheduler already manages emulators, so Windows VMs fit into it without a separate system.
sents.zh: 设备调度器已经通过这类记录来管理模拟器，因此 Windows 虚拟机无需单独的系统即可纳入其中。

sents.en: They also keep the fleet's state durable and visible.
sents.zh: 这些记录还能让集群的状态持久化且可见。

sents.en: If the scheduler restarts, it reads the records and picks up where it left off, and engineers can inspect any pool or VM with standard Kubernetes tools.
sents.zh: 如果调度器重启，它会读取这些记录并从中断处继续，工程师也可以使用标准的 Kubernetes 工具检查任意资源池或虚拟机。

paragraphs.en: Giving a machine out starts with a DeviceClaim , the same object tests use to claim an emulator. The scheduler matches the claim to a ready VM from the right pool and returns that VM's connection addresses to the runner: CDP for browsers, Appium for native apps and the screen stream.
paragraphs.zh: 将一台机器交付出去要从 DeviceClaim 开始，也就是测试用来认领模拟器的同一个对象。 调度器将该认领与来自正确资源池的一台就绪虚拟机进行匹配，并把该虚拟机的连接地址返回给运行器：浏览器使用 CDP，原生应用使用 Appium，屏幕串流则使用相应的地址。

sents.en: Giving a machine out starts with a DeviceClaim , the same object tests use to claim an emulator.
sents.zh: 将一台机器交付出去要从 DeviceClaim 开始，也就是测试用来认领模拟器的同一个对象。

sents.en: The scheduler matches the claim to a ready VM from the right pool and returns that VM's connection addresses to the runner: CDP for browsers, Appium for native apps and the screen stream.
sents.zh: 调度器将该认领与来自正确资源池的一台就绪虚拟机进行匹配，并把该虚拟机的连接地址返回给运行器：浏览器使用 CDP，原生应用使用 Appium，屏幕串流则使用相应的地址。

paragraphs.en: Keeping machines in stock is the job of a reconciler inside the scheduler. It keeps comparing the records against what's actually running in GCE and closes the gap. If a pool is three machines short, it creates three. When a test releases its claim, it deletes that VM. Windows VMs take minutes to create and boot, so the reconciler moves each one forward a step at a time across short passes and writes its progress onto the VM's record. A slow boot never holds up anything else the scheduler manages.
paragraphs.zh: 让机器保持在库存中，是调度器内部一个「协调器」的职责。 它会持续比对记录与 GCE 中实际运行的内容，并消除两者的差距。 如果某个机器池缺少三台机器，它就会创建三台。 当某个测试释放其占用时，它就会删除那台虚拟机。 Windows 虚拟机的创建和启动需要几分钟时间，因此协调器会在多次短暂的轮次中每次把每台虚拟机向前推进一步，并把进度写入该虚拟机的记录中。 缓慢的启动绝不会阻塞调度器所管理的其他任何事情。

sents.en: Keeping machines in stock is the job of a reconciler inside the scheduler.
sents.zh: 让机器保持在库存中，是调度器内部一个「协调器」的职责。

sents.en: It keeps comparing the records against what's actually running in GCE and closes the gap.
sents.zh: 它会持续比对记录与 GCE 中实际运行的内容，并消除两者的差距。

sents.en: If a pool is three machines short, it creates three.
sents.zh: 如果某个机器池缺少三台机器，它就会创建三台。

sents.en: When a test releases its claim, it deletes that VM.
sents.zh: 当某个测试释放其占用时，它就会删除那台虚拟机。

sents.en: Windows VMs take minutes to create and boot, so the reconciler moves each one forward a step at a time across short passes and writes its progress onto the VM's record.
sents.zh: Windows 虚拟机的创建和启动需要几分钟时间，因此协调器会在多次短暂的轮次中每次把每台虚拟机向前推进一步，并把进度写入该虚拟机的记录中。

sents.en: A slow boot never holds up anything else the scheduler manages.
sents.zh: 缓慢的启动绝不会阻塞调度器所管理的其他任何事情。

paragraphs.en: The central tension in desktop test infrastructure is that clean machines are slow and fast machines aren't clean. Rebooting from a fresh image costs minutes, and reusing a machine means each test inherits whatever the last one left behind.
paragraphs.zh: 桌面测试基础设施的核心矛盾在于：干净的机器速度慢，而速度快的机器不干净。 从全新镜像重启需要耗费数分钟，而复用机器则意味着每个测试都会继承上一个测试遗留下来的一切。

sents.en: The central tension in desktop test infrastructure is that clean machines are slow and fast machines aren't clean.
sents.zh: 桌面测试基础设施的核心矛盾在于：干净的机器速度慢，而速度快的机器不干净。

sents.en: Rebooting from a fresh image costs minutes, and reusing a machine means each test inherits whatever the last one left behind.
sents.zh: 从全新镜像重启需要耗费数分钟，而复用机器则意味着每个测试都会继承上一个测试遗留下来的一切。

paragraphs.en: Making machines disposable removes a lot of work that normally comes with a Windows fleet: patching long-running machines, cleaning up after tests, and tracking down why one machine behaves differently from the others.
paragraphs.zh: 将机器视为可丢弃的，免除了管理 Windows 设备群时通常伴随的大量工作：为长期运行的机器打补丁、测试后的清理，以及排查为什么某台机器的表现与其他机器不同。

paragraphs.en: Native apps have no DOM for Playwright to drive, so a stock Windows install can't run automated UI tests. Appium, the Appium Windows driver and Microsoft's WinAppDriver have to be installed, configured and running inside a live desktop session before the first test arrives — all of which we bake into a base machine image. The image also runs a separate root-level session for parts of Windows that don't belong to the app, such as notifications and the Action Center.
paragraphs.zh: 原生应用没有可供 Playwright 驱动的 DOM，因此一个原装的 Windows 系统无法运行自动化 UI 测试。 在第一个测试到来之前，必须先安装、配置并运行 Appium、Appium Windows 驱动程序以及微软的 WinAppDriver，而且要在活动的桌面会话中运行——我们把这一切都预先内置到一个基础机器镜像中。 该镜像还会为不属于应用程序本身的 Windows 部分运行一个单独的 root 级会话，例如通知和操作中心。

sents.en: Native apps have no DOM for Playwright to drive, so a stock Windows install can't run automated UI tests.
sents.zh: 原生应用没有可供 Playwright 驱动的 DOM，因此一个原装的 Windows 系统无法运行自动化 UI 测试。

sents.en: Appium, the Appium Windows driver and Microsoft's WinAppDriver have to be installed, configured and running inside a live desktop session before the first test arrives — all of which we bake into a base machine image.
sents.zh: 在第一个测试到来之前，必须先安装、配置并运行 Appium、Appium Windows 驱动程序以及微软的 WinAppDriver，而且要在活动的桌面会话中运行——我们把这一切都预先内置到一个基础机器镜像中。

sents.en: The image also runs a separate root-level session for parts of Windows that don't belong to the app, such as notifications and the Action Center.
sents.zh: 该镜像还会为不属于应用程序本身的 Windows 部分运行一个单独的 root 级会话，例如通知和操作中心。

paragraphs.en: A PowerShell setup script produces the image and publishes it to an image family in GCE so it's easily reproducible. Nobody hand-maintains a golden machine.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 PowerShell 设置脚本用于生成该镜像，并将其发布到 GCE 中的镜像家族，因此很容易复现。 没有人手动维护一台黄金镜像机器。

sents.en: A PowerShell setup script produces the image and publishes it to an image family in GCE so it's easily reproducible.
sents.zh: 一个 PowerShell 设置脚本用于生成该镜像，并将其发布到 GCE 中的镜像家族，因此很容易复现。

sents.en: Nobody hand-maintains a golden machine.
sents.zh: 没有人手动维护一台黄金镜像机器。

paragraphs.en: The base image includes common software like Google Chrome and Adobe Acrobat, which are frequently called during E2E tests but we also support variants of the base image. For example, an Office image clears Microsoft Word’s first-run dialogs before a test ever sees them.
paragraphs.zh: 基础镜像包含 Google Chrome 和 Adobe Acrobat 等常用软件，这些软件在端到端（E2E）测试中经常被调用，但我们也支持基础镜像的多种变体。 例如，Office 镜像会在测试接触到微软 Word 的首次运行对话框之前就将其清除。

sents.en: The base image includes common software like Google Chrome and Adobe Acrobat, which are frequently called during E2E tests but we also support variants of the base image.
sents.zh: 基础镜像包含 Google Chrome 和 Adobe Acrobat 等常用软件，这些软件在端到端（E2E）测试中经常被调用，但我们也支持基础镜像的多种变体。

sents.en: For example, an Office image clears Microsoft Word’s first-run dialogs before a test ever sees them.
sents.zh: 例如，Office 镜像会在测试接触到微软 Word 的首次运行对话框之前就将其清除。

paragraphs.en: When apps need more than that (licensed third-party software, specific configuration or other apps installed alongside them) we can build private images from a setup script the customer provides.
paragraphs.zh: 当应用需要更多内容时（需要授权的第三方软件、特定配置或随其一起安装的其他应用），我们可以根据客户提供的安装脚本来构建私有镜像。

paragraphs.en: Everything else about running a QA Wolf test (runners, recordings, CI integration, result reporting) is built on Linux. Running test code on Windows would mean building and maintaining two copies of all of it. So test code doesn't run on Windows. It runs in a Linux runner pod and controls the VM remotely, and the VM only runs the app and the automation endpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 关于运行 QA Wolf 测试的其他所有内容（运行器、录制、CI 集成、结果报告）都是构建在 Linux 之上的。 在 Windows 上运行测试代码将意味着构建并维护所有这些东西的两份副本。 因此测试代码不在 Windows 上运行。 它在 Linux 运行器 Pod 中运行并远程控制虚拟机，而虚拟机只运行应用程序和自动化端点。

sents.en: Everything else about running a QA Wolf test (runners, recordings, CI integration, result reporting) is built on Linux.
sents.zh: 关于运行 QA Wolf 测试的其他所有内容（运行器、录制、CI 集成、结果报告）都是构建在 Linux 之上的。

sents.en: Running test code on Windows would mean building and maintaining two copies of all of it.
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上运行测试代码将意味着构建并维护所有这些东西的两份副本。

sents.en: So test code doesn't run on Windows.
sents.zh: 因此测试代码不在 Windows 上运行。

sents.en: It runs in a Linux runner pod and controls the VM remotely, and the VM only runs the app and the automation endpoints.
sents.zh: 它在 Linux 运行器 Pod 中运行并远程控制虚拟机，而虚拟机只运行应用程序和自动化端点。

paragraphs.en: When the runner connects to its VM, it opens two channels to the same machine. Browsers on the VM are reached with Playwright's chromium.connectOverCDP() , and native apps through WebdriverIO and Appium.
paragraphs.zh: 当运行器连接到其虚拟机时，它会向同一台机器打开两个通道。 虚拟机上的浏览器通过 Playwright 的 chromium.connectOverCDP() 访问，原生应用则通过 WebdriverIO 和 Appium 访问。

sents.en: When the runner connects to its VM, it opens two channels to the same machine.
sents.zh: 当运行器连接到其虚拟机时，它会向同一台机器打开两个通道。

sents.en: Browsers on the VM are reached with Playwright's chromium.connectOverCDP() , and native apps through WebdriverIO and Appium.
sents.zh: 虚拟机上的浏览器通过 Playwright 的 chromium.connectOverCDP() 访问，原生应用则通过 WebdriverIO 和 Appium 访问。

paragraphs.en: Test authors see one API. The @qawolf/flows/windows entrypoint provides launch() for browsers and startApp() for native apps, and a single expect uses Playwright's matchers or WebdriverIO's depending on what it's asserting on. A test can sign in through a browser, switch to a native app and check the result without caring which protocol carries each step.
paragraphs.zh: 测试作者只需面对一个 API。 @qawolf/flows/windows 入口为浏览器提供 launch()，为原生应用提供 startApp()，并且单个 expect 会根据断言对象选用 Playwright 的匹配器或 WebdriverIO 的匹配器。 一个测试可以通过浏览器登录，切换到原生应用并检查结果，而无需关心每一步由哪种协议承载。

sents.en: Test authors see one API.
sents.zh: 测试作者只需面对一个 API。

sents.en: The @qawolf/flows/windows entrypoint provides launch() for browsers and startApp() for native apps, and a single expect uses Playwright's matchers or WebdriverIO's depending on what it's asserting on.
sents.zh: @qawolf/flows/windows 入口为浏览器提供 launch()，为原生应用提供 startApp()，并且单个 expect 会根据断言对象选用 Playwright 的匹配器或 WebdriverIO 的匹配器。

sents.en: A test can sign in through a browser, switch to a native app and check the result without caring which protocol carries each step.
sents.zh: 一个测试可以通过浏览器登录，切换到原生应用并检查结果，而无需关心每一步由哪种协议承载。

paragraphs.en: const app = await startApp ( "C:\\qawolf\\apps\\Invoicing.exe" ); await app.$( "~NewInvoiceButton" ). click (); await app.$( "~CustomerName" ). setValue ( "Acme Corp" ); await app.$( "~SaveButton" ). click (); await expect (app.$( "~StatusBar" )). toHaveText ( "Invoice saved" ); The practical effect is that a Windows test looks like any other QA Wolf test, and it runs through the same pipeline.
paragraphs.zh:
```javascript
const app = await startApp ( "C:\\qawolf\\apps\\Invoicing.exe" ); await app.$( "~NewInvoiceButton" ). click (); await app.$( "~CustomerName" ). setValue ( "Acme Corp" ); await app.$( "~SaveButton" ). click (); await expect (app.$( "~StatusBar" )). toHaveText ( "Invoice saved" );
```

实际效果是，Windows 测试看起来与其他任何 QA Wolf 测试一样，并且通过相同的流水线运行。

paragraphs.en: With single-use VMs, the app under test has to reach a new machine on every run, quickly and without opening a security hole. It also often arrives as an installer rather than something ready to launch.
paragraphs.zh: 使用一次性虚拟机时，被测应用必须在每次运行时快速连接到一台新机器，且不能打开安全漏洞。 而且它通常以安装程序的形式到达，而不是可以直接启动的形式。

sents.en: With single-use VMs, the app under test has to reach a new machine on every run, quickly and without opening a security hole.
sents.zh: 使用一次性虚拟机时，被测应用必须在每次运行时快速连接到一台新机器，且不能打开安全漏洞。

sents.en: It also often arrives as an installer rather than something ready to launch.
sents.zh: 而且它通常以安装程序的形式到达，而不是可以直接启动的形式。

paragraphs.en: The app's files never pass through the runner. When a test calls startApp() , the system issues a short-lived signed URL, and the VM downloads the app straight from storage over Private Google Access, a network path that stays inside Google's network. Only QA Wolf's central API service can sign those URLs. Test code runs as an unprivileged user and asks for downloads through a trusted parent process, so the code inside a test can't sign arbitrary URLs.
paragraphs.zh: 应用的文件绝不会经过 runner。 当测试调用 startApp() 时，系统会签发一个短时效的签名 URL，虚拟机通过 Private Google Access 直接从存储下载应用，这条网络路径始终留在 Google 的网络内部。 只有 QA Wolf 的中央 API 服务才能签署这些 URL。 测试代码以无特权的用户身份运行，并通过一个受信任的父进程请求下载，因此测试内部的代码无法签署任意 URL。

sents.en: The app's files never pass through the runner.
sents.zh: 应用的文件绝不会经过 runner。

sents.en: When a test calls startApp() , the system issues a short-lived signed URL, and the VM downloads the app straight from storage over Private Google Access, a network path that stays inside Google's network.
sents.zh: 当测试调用 startApp() 时，系统会签发一个短时效的签名 URL，虚拟机通过 Private Google Access 直接从存储下载应用，这条网络路径始终留在 Google 的网络内部。

sents.en: Only QA Wolf's central API service can sign those URLs.
sents.zh: 只有 QA Wolf 的中央 API 服务才能签署这些 URL。

sents.en: Test code runs as an unprivileged user and asks for downloads through a trusted parent process, so the code inside a test can't sign arbitrary URLs.
sents.zh: 测试代码以无特权的用户身份运行，并通过一个受信任的父进程请求下载，因此测试内部的代码无法签署任意 URL。

paragraphs.en: Once the file lands, the VM handles installation. It supports .exe , .msi and .msix installers, including passing MSI properties, so apps that only ship as installers work the same way as a standalone executable. Tests can also push files to the VM and pull files back, which covers flows like importing a document or checking an exported report.
paragraphs.zh: 文件到达后，虚拟机会处理安装。 它支持 .exe、.msi 和 .msix 安装程序，包括传递 MSI 属性，因此只以安装程序形式发布的应用，其工作方式与独立的可执行文件相同。 测试还可以向虚拟机推送文件并拉取文件，这涵盖了导入文档或检查导出报告等流程。

sents.en: Once the file lands, the VM handles installation.
sents.zh: 文件到达后，虚拟机会处理安装。

sents.en: It supports .exe , .msi and .msix installers, including passing MSI properties, so apps that only ship as installers work the same way as a standalone executable.
sents.zh: 它支持 .exe、.msi 和 .msix 安装程序，包括传递 MSI 属性，因此只以安装程序形式发布的应用，其工作方式与独立的可执行文件相同。

sents.en: Tests can also push files to the VM and pull files back, which covers flows like importing a document or checking an exported report.
sents.zh: 测试还可以向虚拟机推送文件并拉取文件，这涵盖了导入文档或检查导出报告等流程。

paragraphs.en: A remote Windows VM is a black box by default. Writing a test, debugging a failure or reviewing a run all require seeing what the test saw, as it happened.
paragraphs.zh: 远程 Windows 虚拟机默认是一个黑盒。 编写测试、调试失败或审查运行过程，都需要看到测试当时所看到的情形，就像它发生时那样。

sents.en: A remote Windows VM is a black box by default.
sents.zh: 远程 Windows 虚拟机默认是一个黑盒。

sents.en: Writing a test, debugging a failure or reviewing a run all require seeing what the test saw, as it happened.
sents.zh: 编写测试、调试失败或审查运行过程，都需要看到测试当时所看到的情形，就像它发生时那样。

paragraphs.en: Each VM runs a small desktop agent written in Go. It captures the screen with FFmpeg and streams it over WebRTC, and it simulates mouse, keyboard and clipboard input by calling Windows' own user32.dll . The agent doesn't use CGo (Go's bridge to C code), so it cross-compiles for Windows from a Mac or Linux machine, and the platform-specific parts sit behind Go build tags. The Linux, Windows, and Mac agents share one codebase, and the Linux build is unaffected by the Windows code.
paragraphs.zh: 每台虚拟机都运行一个用 Go 编写的小型桌面智能体。 它使用 FFmpeg 捕获屏幕并通过 WebRTC 进行串流，同时通过调用 Windows 自带的 user32.dll 来模拟鼠标、键盘和剪贴板输入。 该智能体不使用 CGo（Go 与 C 代码的桥接），因此可以从 Mac 或 Linux 机器上为 Windows 进行交叉编译，而平台相关的部分则通过 Go 的构建标签进行隔离。 Linux、Windows 和 Mac 的智能体共享同一套代码库，且 Linux 构建不受 Windows 代码的影响。

sents.en: Each VM runs a small desktop agent written in Go.
sents.zh: 每台虚拟机都运行一个用 Go 编写的小型桌面智能体。

sents.en: It captures the screen with FFmpeg and streams it over WebRTC, and it simulates mouse, keyboard and clipboard input by calling Windows' own user32.dll .
sents.zh: 它使用 FFmpeg 捕获屏幕并通过 WebRTC 进行串流，同时通过调用 Windows 自带的 user32.dll 来模拟鼠标、键盘和剪贴板输入。

sents.en: The agent doesn't use CGo (Go's bridge to C code), so it cross-compiles for Windows from a Mac or Linux machine, and the platform-specific parts sit behind Go build tags.
sents.zh: 该智能体不使用 CGo（Go 与 C 代码的桥接），因此可以从 Mac 或 Linux 机器上为 Windows 进行交叉编译，而平台相关的部分则通过 Go 的构建标签进行隔离。

sents.en: The Linux, Windows, and Mac agents share one codebase, and the Linux build is unaffected by the Windows code.
sents.zh: Linux、Windows 和 Mac 的智能体共享同一套代码库，且 Linux 构建不受 Windows 代码的影响。

paragraphs.en: The agent reads the actual screen size from Windows instead of trusting configuration, so the stream always shows the whole desktop at the right scale. It also exposes diagnostics and logs endpoints that report what the capture pipeline and the WebRTC connection are actually doing.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体会从 Windows 读取实际屏幕尺寸，而不是信任配置，因此流始终以正确的比例显示整个桌面。 它还提供诊断和日志端点，用于报告采集流水线和 WebRTC 连接的实际运行情况。

sents.en: The agent reads the actual screen size from Windows instead of trusting configuration, so the stream always shows the whole desktop at the right scale.
sents.zh: 智能体会从 Windows 读取实际屏幕尺寸，而不是信任配置，因此流始终以正确的比例显示整个桌面。

sents.en: It also exposes diagnostics and logs endpoints that report what the capture pipeline and the WebRTC connection are actually doing.
sents.zh: 它还提供诊断和日志端点，用于报告采集流水线和 WebRTC 连接的实际运行情况。

paragraphs.en: For the people using QA Wolf, that adds up to:
paragraphs.zh: 对于使用 QA Wolf 的用户来说，这意味着：

paragraphs.en: Desktop apps often talk to systems behind a firewall: internal APIs, licensing servers, databases, etc. Customers need to know exactly what's connecting to them.
paragraphs.zh: 桌面应用常常需要与防火墙后面的系统通信：内部 API、许可服务器、数据库等。 客户需要确切地知道是什么在连接他们。

sents.en: Desktop apps often talk to systems behind a firewall: internal APIs, licensing servers, databases, etc.
sents.zh: 桌面应用常常需要与防火墙后面的系统通信：内部 API、许可服务器、数据库等。

sents.en: Customers need to know exactly what's connecting to them.
sents.zh: 客户需要确切地知道是什么在连接他们。

paragraphs.en: Windows desktop app testing is now live. It works through the QA Wolf platform and our MCP, using a single API for writing tests across web, iOS, and Android. One test can open a browser with Playwright, control a native app through WebdriverIO and Appium, and check the result with one expect, whether the app runs on the web, on mobile or on a Windows desktop.
paragraphs.zh: Windows 桌面应用测试现已上线。 它通过 QA Wolf 平台和我们的 MCP 运行，使用单一 API 即可跨 Web、iOS 和 Android 编写测试。 无论应用运行在 Web、移动端还是 Windows 桌面上，一个测试都可以用 Playwright 打开浏览器、通过 WebdriverIO 和 Appium 控制原生应用，并用一个 expect 检查结果。

sents.en: Windows desktop app testing is now live.
sents.zh: Windows 桌面应用测试现已上线。

sents.en: It works through the QA Wolf platform and our MCP, using a single API for writing tests across web, iOS, and Android.
sents.zh: 它通过 QA Wolf 平台和我们的 MCP 运行，使用单一 API 即可跨 Web、iOS 和 Android 编写测试。

sents.en: One test can open a browser with Playwright, control a native app through WebdriverIO and Appium, and check the result with one expect, whether the app runs on the web, on mobile or on a Windows desktop.
sents.zh: 无论应用运行在 Web、移动端还是 Windows 桌面上，一个测试都可以用 Playwright 打开浏览器、通过 WebdriverIO 和 Appium 控制原生应用，并用一个 expect 检查结果。

paragraphs.en: QA Wolf AI starts investigating failures while the suite still runs: it groups them by cause, repairs tests only with a passing run, and asks you when product intent is unclear.
paragraphs.zh: QA Wolf AI 在测试套件仍在运行时就开始调查失败：它会按原因对失败进行分组，仅在测试通过运行后才修复测试，并在产品意图不明确时向你提问。

paragraphs.en: QA Wolf, Claude Code, and Codex on the same 1,567 evals across web, iOS, and Android apps. QA Wolf passed 93%, Claude Code 78%, and Codex 74%.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一套覆盖网页、iOS 和 Android 应用的 1,567 个评测上对比 QA Wolf、Claude Code 与 Codex。 QA Wolf 通过了 93%，Claude Code 通过了 78%，Codex 通过了 74%。

sents.en: QA Wolf, Claude Code, and Codex on the same 1,567 evals across web, iOS, and Android apps.
sents.zh: 在同一套覆盖网页、iOS 和 Android 应用的 1,567 个评测上对比 QA Wolf、Claude Code 与 Codex。

sents.en: QA Wolf passed 93%, Claude Code 78%, and Codex 74%.
sents.zh: QA Wolf 通过了 93%，Claude Code 通过了 78%，Codex 通过了 74%。

paragraphs.en: Functional testing checks that software does what users expect. See the types, an example test, functional vs. non-functional, and what to automate first.
paragraphs.zh: 功能测试检查软件是否符合用户的预期。 了解测试的类型、示例测试、功能测试与非功能测试的区别，以及应该优先自动化哪些内容。

sents.en: Functional testing checks that software does what users expect.
sents.zh: 功能测试检查软件是否符合用户的预期。

sents.en: See the types, an example test, functional vs. non-functional, and what to automate first.
sents.zh: 了解测试的类型、示例测试、功能测试与非功能测试的区别，以及应该优先自动化哪些内容。

paragraphs.en: Building for MCP pushed QA Wolf to replace app navigation with focused, task-oriented views. See how designing for coding agents simplified the whole product.
paragraphs.zh: 为 MCP 进行构建促使 QA Wolf 用聚焦的、面向任务的视图取代了应用导航。 了解为编程智能体设计如何简化了整个产品。

sents.en: Building for MCP pushed QA Wolf to replace app navigation with focused, task-oriented views.
sents.zh: 为 MCP 进行构建促使 QA Wolf 用聚焦的、面向任务的视图取代了应用导航。

sents.en: See how designing for coding agents simplified the whole product.
sents.zh: 了解为编程智能体设计如何简化了整个产品。

paragraphs.en: We followed the same customers for 21 months and 50,000 AI-generated PRs: they deployed about 30% more often, reported bugs fell 20%, and bugs per deploy dropped by more than a third.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对同一批客户进行了为期 21 个月的跟踪，涵盖 50,000 个由 AI 生成的 PR：他们的部署频率提高了约 30%，报告的缺陷减少了 20%，且每次部署的缺陷数下降了超过三分之一。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code and Codex can write a Playwright test. At hundreds of PRs a week, QA also needs coverage decisions, a test fleet, and agents that run unattended.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 都能编写 Playwright 测试。 在每周数百个 PR 的规模下，QA 还需要覆盖范围决策、测试机队以及无人值守运行的智能体。

sents.en: Claude Code and Codex can write a Playwright test.
sents.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 都能编写 Playwright 测试。

sents.en: At hundreds of PRs a week, QA also needs coverage decisions, a test fleet, and agents that run unattended.
sents.zh: 在每周数百个 PR 的规模下，QA 还需要覆盖范围决策、测试机队以及无人值守运行的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Agent sessions don't behave like cloud jobs. How we rebuilt our infrastructure so every QA Wolf AI agent gets its own machine with a real filesystem, shell and browser.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体会话的行为不像云端作业。 我们如何重建基础设施，让每个 QA Wolf AI 智能体都拥有自己独立的机器，配备真实的文件系统、shell 和浏览器。

sents.en: Agent sessions don't behave like cloud jobs.
sents.zh: 智能体会话的行为不像云端作业。

sents.en: How we rebuilt our infrastructure so every QA Wolf AI agent gets its own machine with a real filesystem, shell and browser.
sents.zh: 我们如何重建基础设施，让每个 QA Wolf AI 智能体都拥有自己独立的机器，配备真实的文件系统、shell 和浏览器。

paragraphs.en: How we built real-time WebRTC streaming for unattended test runners across web, Android, and iOS—and why one requirement, "it has to feel live," set off a chain reaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何为跨越 Web、Android 和 iOS 的无人值守测试运行器构建实时 WebRTC 流媒体——以及为什么“它必须有实时感”这一项要求引发了一连串反应。
